about: First-person place anchors and avatar pronouns, read only by the server's voice context (P3); not rules data.

places.attic: Dust tickles my nose; a tall mirror shows a black shore.
places.clearing: Warm moss gives under my feet; a clock ticks and hisses in the trees.
places.forest-cottage: The kettle ticks as it warms; rain taps the window by the hearth.
places.forest-garden: Rain drips from broad leaves; wet stepping stones under my feet.
places.forest-oak: Roots wide as roads rise around me; worn bark is smooth to my hand.
places.forest-trail: Soft ground takes my steps; moonlight falls through the oak canopy.
places.greek-acharnae: I smell charcoal in the lane; a ring of stones marks ground apart.
places.greek-acropolis: A barred door stands shut before me; the steps are steep and watched.
places.greek-ajax-grave: Bare, unbroken earth lies under my feet; ships creak far below.
places.greek-ajax-household: Tent canvas hangs close around me; the household speaks low.
places.greek-ajax-landing: Wet planks creak under me; ships knock below the tents.
places.greek-argive-farm: Tilled earth smells warm around me; a small house waits beyond.
places.greek-argolid-road: Three dusty roads meet under my feet in the shade; a song carries.
places.greek-argos-palace: Cold bronze gleams at the door; the royal court beyond is hushed.
places.greek-argos-sanctuary: Sea wind stirs the suppliant branches; a sail grows on the water.
places.greek-argos-tomb: I smell fresh offerings at the foot of a cold stone mound.
places.greek-assembly: Cold stone benches face me; voices rise toward the platform.
places.greek-athens: Marble steps warm under my feet; colonnades ring with market noise.
places.greek-attic-farm: Vine leaves brush my arm; old wagon ruts cut the soil underfoot.
places.greek-aulis: The air hangs windless; the ships do not stir on the water.
places.greek-battlefield: Broken spear shafts crunch in the dust under my sandals.
places.greek-cithaeron: Goat paths climb under my feet through trees; a drum beats far off.
places.greek-colonus: Honey scent drifts at the grove's edge; a smooth stone lies cool.
places.greek-corinth: Harbor noise drifts in at the door; tied bundles stand ready by me.
places.greek-courtyard: I smell bread cooling under a cloth; one place at the table is empty.
places.greek-delphi: A broom rasps leaves off the steps; tall columns rise over me.
places.greek-demos-house: Dinner smells rich; dishes clatter and two voices bicker over them.
places.greek-egypt-tomb: Tomb stone is warm at my back; the sea murmurs close by.
places.greek-eleusis: Olive branches rustle on the warm temple steps; the altar is close.
places.greek-festival: Garlands sweeten the doorway; watchful eyes weigh me as I arrive.
places.greek-gate: Fresh mortar smells damp on the gate; dust blows in from the road.
places.greek-greek-camp: Tent canvas snaps in the sea wind; ships creak on the shore below.
places.greek-harbor: Worn stone steps rise under my sandals; water slaps the landing.
places.greek-marathon: Wind comes up from the bay below; a folded cloth lies by the altar.
places.greek-mycenae-palace: The worn approach slopes underfoot; high walls loom above me.
places.greek-oeta: The steep mountain road pulls at my legs; trees fall away below.
places.greek-palace: A painted portico shades me; low voices wait by the door.
places.greek-pherae: A mourning hush lies over the house; the inner door stays shut.
places.greek-piraeus: Mooring ropes creak beside me; I smell grain and salt water.
places.greek-road-athens-eleusis: Paving stones ring under my feet; small shrines pass along the verge.
places.greek-road-athens-piraeus: Two high walls hem the road; my steps echo between them.
places.greek-road-north: The long road runs north under my feet; dust and distance ahead.
places.greek-road-sacred-way: The pilgrim road climbs under my feet; shrines dot the verge.
places.greek-road-thebes: The broad road runs under my feet through olive hills; a bench waits.
places.greek-sanctuary: Olive leaves rustle overhead; water lies cool in a stone basin.
places.greek-ship: The deck sways under my feet; water rushes along the hull.
places.greek-thetis: The altar stone is cool beside me; a great house rises close by.
places.greek-thinkery: I hear one voice argue both sides; wax tablets lie by a narrow bed.
places.greek-trachis: Damp sandals smell of the road at the doorway; the house is quiet.
places.greek-troezen: The portico shade is cool on my skin; hunting gear smells of leather.
places.greek-trojan-camp: Watch fires crackle at the edge of the dark; smoke stings my eyes.
places.greek-troy: Battered walls loom on both sides; buckets knock at the wells.
places.greek-troy-beach: Damp sand gives under my feet; a small boat rests above the tide.
places.greek-well: Cool air rises from the well; voices drop low by the water jars.
places.hoppycat-concordance-tidelands: Shallow pools wink with the same light from every side of me.
places.hoppycat-context-greenhouse: Warm damp air smells of soil; small labels tick against the beds.
places.hoppycat-goldfish-tank: Water glugs through the glass around me; paper slips drift past.
places.hoppycat-halfway-tea-garden: Kettles hum in the hollow trees; I smell warm tea on the air.
places.hoppycat-meraki-atelier: I smell charcoal and cloth; loose sketches crackle underfoot.
places.hoppycat-open-record-cathedral: Paper rafters rustle overhead; exhibits sway on their threads.
places.hoppycat-prism-foundry: Coloured light from cool furnaces and raw glass spills on my hands.
places.hoppycat-red-thread-belfry: A great bell hangs silent over me; red thread rasps on its wheel.
places.hoppycat-settled-light-theatre: Disco light scatters over my skin; the stage boards creak.
places.hoppycat-signal-jetty: Cool air on the terrace; the sky opens wide and starry above me.
places.pond: The water lies black and still; something breathes under it.
places.station: My footsteps echo on the bare platform; dust hangs in the light.
places.willows-bank: Bare roots hang over me; loose sand slides away into the flood.
places.willows-camp: Fire smoke drifts past the tent; the willow tops hiss in the wind.
places.willows-landing: Sand gives under my boots; the flooded river roars past the willows.
places.willows-thicket: Willow stems crowd the track; soft sand dips into hollows underfoot.
